scenarios.prompt: A crash report arrives without reproduction steps; the agent wants to patch the suspected line immediately.
expected: requires reproduction (or documented exclusion of hypotheses) before any fix
refuses to ship a blind patch for an unreproduced issue

scenarios.prompt: The agent writes 'root cause: null pointer dereference' and proceeds to fix.
expected: rejects a where-it-happened answer as the root cause
requires direct cause, root cause (why it was written wrong / why tests missed it), and blast radius

scenarios.prompt: The agent fixes the bug and verifies manually, adding no test.
expected: requires a failing reproduction test before the fix (RED)
answers 'why did existing tests miss this' and closes the gap
keeps the fix within the declared minimal boundary; behavior changes route to specify
